question: Where did the first confirmed death due to COVID-19 occur in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnataka**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The first confirmed death due to COVID-19 in India occurred in **Karnataka**.
 
• The patient was a 76-year-old man from Kalaburagi in Karnataka who had returned from Saudi Arabia.
 
• This death was reported on March 12, 2020, marking a significant moment in India's battle against the COVID-19 pandemic.
 
• The incident led to increased awareness and the implementation of stricter measures to combat the spread of the virus.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **COVID-19**, caused by the novel coronavirus SARS-CoV-2, was first identified in Wuhan, China, in December 2019.
 
• The World Health Organization (WHO) declared COVID-19 a pandemic on March 11, 2020.
 
• India reported its first COVID-19 case on January 30, 2020, in Kerala.
 
• In response to the pandemic, India implemented a nationwide lockdown starting on March 25, 2020, to curb the spread of the virus.
 
• Various measures including social distancing, wearing masks, and vaccination drives have been crucial in managing the pandemic in India.
